name: DISH Network Military & First Responder Discount
description: Free Stars & Stripes pack + monthly free movie rental + 2-year price guarantee for military and first responders
fullDescription: DISH Network offers a special bonus for military members, veterans, and first responders, including the Stars & Stripes channel pack at no cost, a free On Demand movie rental each month, and a 2-year TV price guarantee.
whatTheyOffer:
- Stars & Stripes channel pack at no cost ($240 value over 2 years)
- Channels include American Heroes Channel, Smithsonian Channel, and more
- First On Demand movie rental each month free
- 2-year TV price guarantee starting at $94.99/mo (America's Top 120 with Hopper 3 DVR)
- Stream live and recorded TV on mobile devices with DISH Anywhere (compatible Hopper required)
howToGetIt:
1. Call DISH at 1-877-621-0194 or visit dish.com/offers/military-offer (first responders: dish.com/offers/first-responder-offer)
2. Verify your military, veteran, or first responder status
3. Credit qualification and eAutoPay required
4. 2-year commitment required ($20/mo early termination fee if canceled early)
5. Taxes, fees, and equipment for additional TVs cost extra
keywords: DISH, satellite TV, military discount, veteran, first responder, Stars and Stripes, Hopper DVR, DISH Anywhere
